name: PU-CI Wheels
full_name: PU-CI Wheels & Castors (Polyurethane on Cast Iron)
intro: PU-CI wheels have polyurethane bonded over a cast iron core by a casting process. They combine high load capacity and impact strength with low rolling friction, are floor-friendly and resist oil, grease and chemicals. Available as wheel only, fixed caster, swivel caster and swivel caster with brake.
features: Polyurethane bonded/moulded over Cast Iron core — casting process
High load capacity / High impact strength / Low rolling friction / Floor-friendly
Hardness: 95 Shore A / Excellent wear resistance
Resistant to oil, grease and chemicals / Max Working Temperature: 70°C
Widely used in Pallet Trucks, Stackers, Drum Tilters, Floor Cranes, Battery operated equipment
Cast polyurethane is MUCH BETTER than injection moulded — higher load capacity and service life
